import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from makemarket.evaluate import load_results
from makemarket.provenance import receipt, file_sha256
from makemarket.scoring import bootstrap_ci, episode_metrics, paired_ratio_ci

root=Path('results/kaggle/staged-validation-v1')
r={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'paired SFT versus SFT+GRPO validation ablation','bootstrap_resamples':10000,'bootstrap_seed':0},'3764fa359b9082ea5a1e4a5e3ac3aaf6e9671636'),
   'source_sha256':file_sha256(__file__),'calculation_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),
   'seeds':list(range(80000,80100)),'input_sha256':{},'games':{},
   'interpretation':'Descriptive validation ablation conditional on one frozen training pipeline. These episodes selected the game router; intervals are not held-out confirmation or training-seed uncertainty.'}
for game in ('dice','cards'):
 arrays={}
 for method in ('sft','grpo'):
  label='qwen3.5-4b-staged-'+method
  for player in (label,'bayes'):
   p=root/label/'results/raw'/game/(player+'.jsonl')
   rows=sorted(load_results(p),key=lambda row:row['seed'])
   assert [row['seed'] for row in rows]==r['seeds']
   r['input_sha256'][str(p)]=file_sha256(p)
   metrics=[episode_metrics(row) for row in rows]
   values={k:np.array([row[k] for row in metrics]) for k in ('epnl','noise_edge','adverse_cost','fail_rate')}
   if player=='bayes' and 'bayes' in arrays:
    assert np.array_equal(values['epnl'],arrays['bayes']['epnl'])
   arrays['bayes' if player=='bayes' else method]=values
 delta=arrays['grpo']['epnl']-arrays['sft']['epnl']
 pct,lo,hi=paired_ratio_ci(delta,arrays['bayes']['epnl'])
 r['games'][game]={'grpo_minus_sft_epnl':float(delta.mean()),'paired_95_ci':bootstrap_ci(delta),
                   'paired_97_5_ci_two_game_correction':bootstrap_ci(delta,level=.975),
                   'grpo_minus_sft_percentage_points_of_bayes':float(pct),'paired_percentage_point_95_ci':[lo,hi],
                   'mean_changes':{k:float((arrays['grpo'][k]-arrays['sft'][k]).mean()) for k in ('noise_edge','adverse_cost','fail_rate')}}
Path('results/validation/staged_ablation.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(r['games'],indent=2))
